notes: The packet lists field:mavlink/mavlink_message_t.magic as provided by libmavconn, but at this revision the struct and its magic field are defined only in the external mavlink package (C/C++ header mavlink_types.h, pulled in via mavlink/v2.0/<dialect>/<dialect>.hpp through the generated mavconn/mavlink_dialect.h). libmavconn therefore does not declare the element (not_declared) and consumes it (references). QoS null because this is ROS 1 and the element is an in-process C struct field, not a topic. The references list is restricted to names bound to this element (the field, its parent struct, and the MAVLINK_STX constant it is compared with); libmavconn references many other mavlink symbols (mavlink_status_t, mavlink_frame_char_buffer, mavlink_msg_to_send_buffer, etc.) that are not listed.
